019/**
020 * The {@code TrackMateConfig} class represents configuration parameters used in a
021 * tracking system. It encapsulates various settings related to frame gap,
022 * localization techniques, distance thresholds, and track management
023 * functionalities like merging and splitting.
024 *
025 * <p>This class is immutable as all properties are final and set through
026 * constructors. This allows for thread-safe usage and ensures the
027 * configuration data remains consistent throughout the application.</p>
028 *
029 * <p>Key capabilities:
030 * <ul>
031 *   <li>Specification of tracking parameters such as maximum frame gap, linking
032 *       costs, maximum allowed distances for linking, gap closing, splitting,
033 *       and merging.</li>
034 *   <li>Enabling or disabling specific track behaviors such as subpixel
035 *       localization, track merging, splitting, and gap closing.</li>
036 *   <li>Setting constraints on track construction, including minimum spots per
037 *       track, maximum spots in an image, and other related parameters.</li>
038 *   <li>Configuration of optional operations such as median filtering.</li>
039 *   <li>Provides a utility method to write the configuration to a file in a
040 *       structured string form.</li>
041 * </ul>
042 * </p>
043 */
044public class TrackMateConfig {
045
046    private final int     maxFrameGap;
047    private final double  alternativeLinkingCostFactor;
048    private final boolean doSubpixelLocalization;
049    private final int     minNumberOfSpotsInTrack;
050    private final double  linkingMaxDistance;
051    private final int     maxNumberOfSpotsInImage;
052    private final int     maxNumberOfSecondsPerImage;
053    private final double  gapClosingMaxDistance;
054    private final int     targetChannel;
055    private final double  splittingMaxDistance;
056    private final String  trackColouring;
057    private final double  radius;
058    private final boolean allowGapClosing;
059    private final boolean medianFiltering;
060    private final boolean allowTrackSplitting;
061    private final boolean allowTrackMerging;
062    private final double  mergingMaxDistance;
063    private final boolean runGenerateSquaresAfter;
064    private final boolean deterministicTracking;
065    private final boolean excludeEdgeTracks;
066
067    /**
068     * Constructs a configuration object for TrackMate using the parameters provided
069     * in the given PaintConfig instance. The configuration parameters set here are
070     * used for defining track-related operations such as linking, merging, splitting,
071     * and visualization.
072     */
073    public TrackMateConfig() {
074        
075        this.maxFrameGap                  = PaintConfig.getInt(     TRACKMATE, MAX_FRAME_GAP, 3);
076        this.alternativeLinkingCostFactor = PaintConfig.getDouble(  TRACKMATE, ALTERNATIVE_LINKING_COST_FACTOR,1.05);
077        this.doSubpixelLocalization       = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, DO_SUBPIXEL_LOCALIZATION,       false);
078        this.minNumberOfSpotsInTrack      = PaintConfig.getInt(     TRACKMATE, MIN_NR_SPOTS_IN_TRACK,          3);
079        this.linkingMaxDistance           = PaintConfig.getDouble(  TRACKMATE, LINKING_MAX_DISTANCE,           0.6);
080        this.maxNumberOfSpotsInImage      = PaintConfig.getInt(     TRACKMATE, MAX_NR_SPOTS_IN_IMAGE,          2000000);
081        this.maxNumberOfSecondsPerImage   = PaintConfig.getInt(     TRACKMATE, MAX_NR_SECONDS_PER_IMAGE,       2000);
082        this.gapClosingMaxDistance        = PaintConfig.getDouble(  TRACKMATE, GAP_CLOSING_MAX_DISTANCE,       1.2);
083        this.targetChannel                = PaintConfig.getInt(     TRACKMATE, TARGET_CHANNEL,                 1);
084        this.splittingMaxDistance         = PaintConfig.getDouble(  TRACKMATE, SPLITTING_MAX_DISTANCE,         15.0);
085        this.trackColouring               = PaintConfig.getString(  TRACKMATE, TRACK_COLOURING,                "TRACK_DURATION");
086        this.radius                       = PaintConfig.getDouble(  TRACKMATE, RADIUS,                         0.5);
087        this.allowGapClosing              = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, ALLOW_GAP_CLOSING,              true);
088        this.medianFiltering              = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, DO_MEDIAN_FILTERING,            false);
089        this.allowTrackSplitting          = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, ALLOW_TRACK_SPLITTING,          false);
090        this.allowTrackMerging            = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, ALLOW_TRACK_MERGING,            false);
091        this.mergingMaxDistance           = PaintConfig.getDouble(  TRACKMATE, MERGING_MAX_DISTANCE,           15.0);
092        this.runGenerateSquaresAfter      = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, RUN_GENERATE_SQUARES_AFTER,     false);
093        this.deterministicTracking        = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, DETERMINISTIC_TRACKING,         false);
094        this.excludeEdgeTracks            = PaintConfig.getBoolean( TRACKMATE, EXCLUDE_EDGE_TRACKS,            true);
095    }
096
097
098    // Getters only, Setter methods are not needed either, as the attributes are final
099
100    /**
101     * @return the maximum allowed gap in frames between two spots in a track.
102     */
103    public int getMaxFrameGap() {
104        return maxFrameGap;
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * @return factor used for alternative linking cost calculations.
109     */
110    public double getAlternativeLinkingCostFactor() {

112    }
113
114    /**
115     * @return {@code true} if subpixel localization is enabled.
116     */
117    public boolean isDoSubpixelLocalization() {
118        return doSubpixelLocalization;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * @return the minimum required number of spots for a valid track.
123     */
124    public int getMinNumberOfSpotsInTrack() {
125        return minNumberOfSpotsInTrack;
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * @return the maximum distance allowed for linking two spots.
130     */
131    public double getLinkingMaxDistance() {
132        return linkingMaxDistance;
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * @return the maximum number of spots allowed per image.
137     */
138    public int getMaxNumberOfSpotsInImage() {
139        return maxNumberOfSpotsInImage;
140    }
141
142    /**
143     * @return the maximum processing time allowed per image in seconds.
144     */
145    public int getMaxNumberOfSecondsPerImage() {
146        return maxNumberOfSecondsPerImage;
147    }
148
149    /**
150     * @return the maximum distance allowed for closing gaps between track segments.
151     */
152    public double getGapClosingMaxDistance() {
153        return gapClosingMaxDistance;
154    }
155
156    /**
157     * @return the target image channel for tracking.
158     */
159    public int getTargetChannel() {
160        return targetChannel;
161    }
162
163    /**
164     * @return the maximum distance allowed for track splitting.
165     */
166    public double getSplittingMaxDistance() {
167        return splittingMaxDistance;
168    }
169
170    /**
171     * @return the color mode used for track visualization.
172     */
173    public String getTrackColoring() {
174        return trackColouring;
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * @return the radius of spots to be tracked.
179     */
180    public double getRadius() {
181        return radius;
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * @return {@code true} if gap closing is allowed.
186     */
187    public boolean isAllowGapClosing() {
188        return allowGapClosing;
189    }
190
191    /**
192     * @return {@code true} if median filtering is enabled.
193     */
194    public boolean isMedianFiltering() {
195        return medianFiltering;
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * @return {@code true} if track splitting is allowed.
200     */
201    public boolean isAllowTrackSplitting() {
202        return allowTrackSplitting;
203    }
204
205    /**
206     * @return {@code true} if track merging is allowed.
207     */
208    public boolean isAllowTrackMerging() {
209        return allowTrackMerging;
210    }
211

213     * @return the maximum distance allowed for track merging.
214     */
215    public double getMergingMaxDistance() {
216        return mergingMaxDistance;
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * @return {@code true} if Generate Squares should run automatically after TrackMate (default {@code false}).
221     */
222    public boolean isRunGenerateSquaresAfter() {
223        return runGenerateSquaresAfter;
224    }
225
226    /**
227     * Whether TrackMate links spots on a single thread.
228     * <p>
229     * With several threads (the default), TrackMate's linking is not reproducible: the same
230     * recording with the same settings can give slightly different tracks from run to run.
231     * On a single thread the result is reproducible, but linking is considerably slower.
232     * See {@code doc/Change Note - TrackMate Determinism and Single Detection.md}.
233     *
234     * @return {@code true} to link on a single thread (default {@code false}, all threads)
235     */
236    public boolean isDeterministicTracking() {
237        return deterministicTracking;
238    }
239
240    /**
241     * Whether tracks present in the first or the last analysed frame are excluded.
242     * <p>
243     * For such a track the real duration is unknown: it may have started before the
244     * recording began, or continued after it ended. Its measured duration is only a lower
245     * bound, which would bias durations, and therefore Tau, towards shorter values.
246     * Excluded tracks are not written to the tracks file and are not counted or drawn.
247     * See {@code doc/Change Note - Exclude Edge Tracks.md}.
248     *
249     * @return {@code true} to exclude edge tracks (default {@code true}, also when the key is absent)
250     */
251    public boolean isExcludeEdgeTracks() {
252        return excludeEdgeTracks;
253    }
254
255    @Override
256    public String toString() {
257
258        return "TrackMateConfig" + "\n" +
259                "                  Max Frame Gap                   = "  + maxFrameGap + "\n" +
260                "                  Alternative Linking Cost Factor = "  + alternativeLinkingCostFactor + "\n" +
261                "                  Do Subpixel Localization        = "  + doSubpixelLocalization + "\n" +
262                "                  Min Number of Spots In Track    = "  + minNumberOfSpotsInTrack + "\n" +
263                "                  Linking Max Distance            = "  + linkingMaxDistance + "\n" +
264                "                  Max Number of Spots in Image    = "  + maxNumberOfSpotsInImage + "\n" +
265                "                  Max Number of Seconds per Image = "  + maxNumberOfSecondsPerImage + "\n" +
266                "                  Gap Closing Max Distance        = "  + gapClosingMaxDistance + "\n" +
267                "                  Target Channel                  = "  + targetChannel + "\n" +
268                "                  Splitting Max Distance          = "  + splittingMaxDistance + "\n" +
269                "                  Track Coloring                  = '" + trackColouring + '\'' + "\n" +
270                "                  Radius                          = "  + radius + "\n" +
271                "                  Allow Gap Closing               = "  + allowGapClosing + "\n" +
272                "                  Do Median Filtering             = "  + medianFiltering + "\n" +
273                "                  Allow Track Splitting           = "  + allowTrackSplitting + "\n" +
274                "                  Allow Track Merging             = "  + allowTrackMerging + "\n" +
275                "                  Merging Max Distance            = "  + mergingMaxDistance + "\n" +
276                "                  Run Generate Squares After      = "  + runGenerateSquaresAfter + "\n" +
277                "                  Deterministic Tracking          = "  + deterministicTracking + "\n" +
278                "                  Exclude Edge Tracks             = "  + excludeEdgeTracks + "\n";
279    }
280}
